rule: Utterances never name a capability id, package or tool; the expected capability is held by the evaluator only.
utterances: What's the next meeting I have coming up?
When is my next scheduled appointment?
Can you check what I have next on my schedule?
I forgot what's coming up next for me. What's my next commitment on the agenda?
Tell me the time and title of my upcoming appointment.
Do I have anything booked soon? Give me the very next one.
Look up my next meeting, please, just tell me when it is.
Qual é o meu próximo compromisso na agenda?
